name: Xiaomi Mi TV (MiTV-MOOQ0, croods; includes P1 43" EU variant)
warnings: NetflixObserver is inside the core com.mediatek.tv.service APK; keep that service enabled.
With PatchWall and katniss off the PatchWall button and the mic do nothing; the Okko, ivi and KinoPoisk app buttons work, and held volume still repeats with no key helper enabled.

Notes from a second set on the same firmware (mirhnaz, PR #81): - Live TV (com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter) can't be disabled even if you never use the tuner: its TurnkeyUiMainActivity is also the HDMI/AV window.
